name: grcg7b
key_challenge: ERV content (EAV-HP), macro/microchromosome size range stresses seed distribution

download.command: datasets download genome accession GCF_016699485.2 --include genome --filename ncbi_dataset.zip && unzip -o ncbi_dataset.zip && cat ncbi_dataset/data/GCF_016699485.2/*.fna > reference.fasta && rm -rf ncbi_dataset ncbi_dataset.zip

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 30 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: ERV content and macro/microchromosome size range (~1 Mb to ~200 Mb) stress k-mer seed distribution differently across chromosomes. Partition accuracy by chromosome size class.
